question: When does registration close for a workshop?
candidate_answer: Registration closes 48 hours before the workshop starts.

question: What credit do I get if I cancel four days before?
candidate_answer: A cancellation four days before the start receives a full account credit.

question: How early should I request accessibility support, and when will someone reply?
candidate_answer: Send the request at least five calendar days before the workshop.

question: Can I enter 10 minutes late?
candidate_answer: Yes. Entry is allowed up to 15 minutes late. Reception can replay the safety briefing at any time.

question: When will my online workshop link arrive?
candidate_answer: The link is emailed 24 hours before the start.

question: Does the centre provide lunch?
candidate_answer: I cannot answer this from the provided workshop policies.

question: I attended all sessions. When will my certificate arrive?
candidate_answer: After you complete every session, the certificate arrives by email within three working days.

question: How many people can join a group booking, and does each person need an email?
candidate_answer: A group can include up to six participants, and each person needs a separate email address.

question: When must I return loaned equipment?
candidate_answer: Return loaned equipment within ten calendar days after the workshop.
